verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent-hosting platform with an API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, test API keys or isolated non-production environment. Approval gates, role-based access and self-hosting are adjacent controls, not a sandbox, and they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
